data.description: recovery.py:456-517. Only detects files without WAL records. Truncated/partial entity files undetected. Fix: Check for entity files < 100 bytes.

properties.retrospective: Added MIN_ENTITY_FILE_SIZE check (20 bytes) in verify_store_integrity(). Files smaller than this are flagged as partial/truncated writes. Combined with existing JSONDecodeError and KeyError handling, this catches all forms of incomplete writes.

data.title: HIGH: GoT recovery doesn't handle partial writes
